name: legal-harness
description: Higher-order harness for the tau2-bench legal domain (NSW boutique-firm client intake under the Legal Profession Uniform Law). Decomposes legal/policy.md by altitude: the ordered intake procedure and its steps become progressively-disclosed skills, the costs-disclosure tier and fee-validation arithmetic becomes a deterministic script, the fee rules and disclosure-threshold invariants become a PreToolUse hook the agent cannot route around, and an intake-auditor sub-agent re-checks open-matter preconditions against live state. The domain tools are supplied by the fork's legal MCP server.
